title: Configuration validity clauses
statement: For a machine and natural numbers $n,s$, define a CNF formula by concatenating clauses that require exactly one of the $n+2$ input-head positions and exactly one of the machine's state indices to be selected; for each work tape, exactly one of the $2s+1$ head-position flags to be selected; for every work-tape cell in that range, prohibit either of its two symbol flags from being true; and require at least one of the two summary flags to be true.
